coverage: The five boroughs of New York City. Surrounding counties are not covered.
method: Join shoreline-clipped NYC DCP 2020 tract polygons to Census 2020 TIGERweb GEOID. Density = POP100 / (AREALAND / 1,000,000), in residents per km² of land. Coordinates rounded to 6 decimal places; no geometry-based area calculation. Two offshore-only tracts with zero population and land area are omitted. Any included tract with zero official land area has no density value.

boundary_vintages.tracts: 2020 census geography, NYC DCP current shoreline representation

attribution: Population and land area: U.S. Census Bureau. Shoreline polygons and borough boundaries: NYC Department of City Planning / NYC Open Data.
interpretation: Residential density averaged across each census tract; not daytime occupancy, ridership demand or a building-level count.

jobs.method: Sum C000 from S000/JT00 Workplace Area Characteristics by first 11 digits of w_geocode (2020 census tract GEOID), then divide by 2020 Census land area in km². All NYC workplace records match shoreline tracts. Tracts without a WAC record have zero covered jobs.
jobs.interpretation: Covered jobs at workplaces, not employed residents or unique workers. All jobs (JT00), including secondary jobs; LEHD coverage does not include all employment. Tract average, not individual office locations.
